text: How is the reservoir trained to produce the gait, and which weights are modified?
choices: FORCE learning with teacher forcing: an online RLS rule updates only the readout W_out, while W_rec and W_in stay fixed
Backpropagation through time updates W_rec, W_in, and W_out jointly
Ridge regression on W_rec so the recurrent dynamics themselves become periodic
Hebbian plasticity applied to the input weights W_in only
explanation: force_train_gait feeds the target y*(t-1) as the input (teacher forcing) and applies an RLS (recursive least squares) update to W_out at every step: this is classic FORCE. W_rec and W_in are built once and never trained, exactly as in reservoir computing. Options 1-3 all wrongly modify the recurrent or input weights.
